source_tier: buyer primary disclosure (HELLENiQ ENERGY) + seller primary disclosure (Edison/EDF) — two independent parties to the same transaction
source_notes: HELLENiQ ENERGY completed the acquisition of the remaining 50% of Elpedison B.V. on 2025-07-15, becoming sole (100%) shareholder; Edison (EDF group) sold its 50% for EUR 164m (+EUR 19m for cash reserves) and did not submit a counter-offer, ending the 15-year JV. Corroborated by two independent counterparties: HELLENiQ's own completion press release (PASS on token '50%') and Edison's board announcement accepting the offer (edison.it, PASS on tokens '50%' and 'HELLENiQ'). Elpedison itself still owns the Thessaloniki FSRU 100% (Owner field unchanged); only the PARENT changes from the EDF/Hellenic Petroleum 50/50 JV to HELLENiQ at 100%. GEM's Thessaloniki row was LastUpdated 2025-07-16 (one day after completion) but the parent split was not updated. Re-sourced off-GEM: the prior draft's second helleniq.gr regulatory-announcement URL failed the token check and was replaced with the independent Edison disclosure.
scope_note: Single-unit terminal; project-level field. No dedicated 'Parent [ref]' column in GEM schema, so the parent source is recorded against Owner [ref] (Owner/Parent are paired). NOTE the GEM Entity ID for the new parent is ambiguous between two existing IDs and is flagged in qa, not guessed here.
